# Sivaram Pandariganthan

> Full-stack product engineer with 8+ years across AI platforms, crypto & payment systems, smart contracts (EVM, Solana), analytics infrastructure, mobile apps, and developer tools. Available for freelance work. Based in India, working remotely worldwide.

Self-taught engineer, shipping since 2018 across startups, client work, and his own products. At his best owning a whole system end to end (design, build, deploy, operate), and has done it solo for products handling real users and real money.

## Featured Work

- [InferPlane](https://sivaramp.com/#featured-work): AI control plane for teams: governed model access, credit metering, retained LLM request logs, audit trails across providers (in stealth)
- [stackfight](https://stackfight.sivaram.dev): Credit-billing and AI-usage-metering platform on Cloudflare Workers, exercised in production by live agent-vs-agent games (open source)
- [1-cent-requests](https://1cent.sivaram.dev): Live x402 pay-per-request API marketplace, 14 endpoints for AI agents at $0.01 each, settled in USDC (open source)
- [varam.chat](https://varam-chat.sivaramp.com): Self-hosted multi-model AI chat platform routing 23 models through OpenRouter, with full inference telemetry (invite-only)
- [Varam Analytics](https://varam-analytics.sivaramp.com): Self-hosted, cookieless web analytics on TimescaleDB, running in production (invite-only)
- [Signal Brief](https://dev.to/sivarampg): Cost-aware multi-source LLM research pipeline over X, Reddit & Hacker News at ~$1/day (internal tooling; public output on dev.to)

## Selected Client Work (closed source, architecture walkthroughs available)

- [SuperPower](https://sivaramp.com/#selected-client-work): Crypto-native platform selling autonomous AI agents for USDT on BNB Chain, with auto-provisioned dedicated VMs. Built and operated solo in 15 weeks.
- [Prolly.so](https://sivaramp.com/#selected-client-work): AI-powered on-chain prediction-market platform with a multi-LLM consensus oracle, built as sole engineer over ~13 months.
- [SpotRoyale](https://sr-app-9f4e.vercel.app): Fractional music-royalty marketplace minting ERC-721 ownership certificates on Polygon mainnet.

## Open Source & Tools

- [Prediction Market Contracts](https://github.com/SivaramPg/evm-simple-prediction-market-contract): Parimutuel binary prediction markets for EVM and Solana, with a guide series on dev.to
- [pwa-icons](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pwa-icons): npm CLI turning one image into 118 production-ready PWA icons (2.5k+ downloads)
- [Site Metadata Explorer](https://site-metadata.sivaramp.com): Audits a site's entire metadata surface in one scan
- [rawdocs](https://sivaramp.com/#open-source-and-tools): Database-free docs proxy serving GitHub markdown to humans and LLMs (redeploying)
- [Tuulkit](https://tuulkit.sixstrides.com): 25 browser-based developer utilities at the edge
- [markdownbin](https://mdbin.sivaramp.com): Zero-knowledge markdown pastebin with client-side AES-256-GCM encryption
- [Swapi.info](https://swapi.info): The Star Wars API, rebuilt for reliability
- [Anaek Desilog](https://desilog.sivaramp.com): Free CC0 Desi/Indian placeholder-image APIs
